designs.title: Playa Venao
designs.why: I've been to Venao, and the horseshoe beach with the wave peeling in looks right. I'd buy it as a trip memento, though at $50 it feels a bit generic.
designs.fix: Show the actual left/right peak in the middle of the bay a bit more clearly; that's what surfers remember.

designs.title: San Juan del Sur
designs.why: Instantly recognisable: the Jesus statue on the hill, the bay full of boats, sunset. That's exactly SJdS, and I'd wear it. The 'Tacos' sign is a bit off for Nicaragua.
designs.fix: Change 'Tacos' to something Nica, like 'Toña' or 'Gallo Pinto'.

designs.title: Haleiwa
designs.why: Looks nice, but that's Diamond Head; you can't see it from Haleiwa. Anyone who's surfed the North Shore will notice, and I wouldn't pay $50 for a shirt that gets the place wrong.
designs.fix: Put the right mountains in, the Waianae side as seen from Haleiwa, and it's a buy.
